# References and Citations {#sec-referencing}

Quarto supports citation management through BibTeX and a .bib file in the normal way.

## Connecting the Bibliography

Add the bibliography file to your YAML:

```yaml
---
bibliography: references.bib
csl: harvard-university-of-bath.csl
---
```


::: {.callout-note}

A copy of the [Harvard Bath style file](https://library.bath.ac.uk/harvard-bath/style-files) is included in these notes. 

:::


##Citing Sources

Citations can be added using citation keys.

```markdown
A single citation for literate programming @knuth84.
```

A single citation for literate programming @knuth84.


Multiple citations:

```markdown
Multiple citations can be cited like this [@knuth84; @le2026quarto]. 
```

Multiple citations can be cited like this [@knuth84; @le2026quarto]. 

## Reference list

A reference list is generated automatically at the end of each chapter page. 

If you prefer one single reference list for the whole book, include a separate chapter with a specific call to the reference list:

```markdown
# References {.unnumbered}
::: {#refs}
:::
```
